Maya R: Quick question 1 VendorsTech (Ireland) invoiced Feb and Mar but they sent a W-9 instead of W-8BEN-E. Payments team flagged 30% withholding on the wire today. Can finance confirm we should withhold or ask for corrected docs?
Aisha (Finance): If vendor is an Irish entity (non-US), we need W-8BEN-E to certify foreign status and claim treaty benefits. A W-9 implies US person. Do we have vendor address/registration showing Ireland?
VendorOps Bot: Vendor record: VendorsTech Ltd, country=IE, VAT=IE3456789, business type=LLC (Irish), payment currency=USD, tax docs uploaded: w9_vendors_2026-02-10.pdf.
Maya R: Their AP sent W-9 by mistake and said they'd upload W-8BEN-E "by EOD" but payment cut is today.
Aisha (Finance): Process: 1) If vendor is foreign and no valid W-8 on file at payment date, withholding of 30% is required under US tax rules for US-source FDAP unless treaty claim provided. 2) For services performed outside US, income may be foreign-source and not subject to US withholding, but we need documentation. 3) We should suspend gross-up requests until we confirm treaty status.
Santiago (Legal): Confirming: Request W-8BEN-E completed and signed, with chapter 3/61 claim if applicable. If they claim treaty (Ireland), need Part III treaty article & rate. If they can't provide W-8, withholding stands.
Maya R: Vendor says services delivered remotely from Ireland and requests gross-up (they want Redwood to pay the 30% on top). Do we have policy?
Aisha (Finance): We rarely gross-up. Need exec approval and PO amendment. Also check contract: who bears taxes? If contract is silent, default is vendor responsibility.
Ben P: If vendor wants gross-up, estimate additional cost ~ tax/(1-tax) so for $10k invoice at 30% withholding, gross-up ~ $4,285 (so we pay $14,285 to net them $10k). Need legal + finance sign-off.
Maya R: I'll pause payment and ask vendor to upload W-8BEN-E and provide statement of where services were performed. I'll also ask if they accept credit application when W-8 is provided (to refund withheld amounts).
Santiago (Legal): Suggest language to vendor: "Please upload a signed W-8BEN-E claiming non-U.S. status and, if claiming treaty benefits, complete Part III with treaty article. Also confirm location where services were performed and whether you request refund of any withholding upon certificate acceptance."
Aisha (Finance): Good. If they upload W-8 within 30 days and it's backdated to cover payment date, we may be able to refund withholding depending on US tax rules; coordinate with tax advisor.
Maya R: Sent vendor note and paused wire. Will update thread when docs uploaded.
VendorOps Bot: Vendor uploaded w8bene_vendors_2026-03-02.pdf (pending review).
Aisha (Finance): Received. I'll review then loop in tax advisor before deciding on refund vs gross-up.
Maya R: Thanks 1 Will follow up.
Ben P: Keep me posted if gross-up requested; will need budget approval.
